# workload/

Labelled workload windows cut from DGXMM's own minute metrics of a test deployment while
`scripts/decider_eval/traffic.py` replayed synthetic chat, agent, batch, RAG, mixed and idle traffic, made with
`scripts/decider_eval/workload_fixtures.py`. `raw/` keeps the traffic phases and minute rollups they were cut from.
Generated by this project; no user traffic.
